detail.body:
## Motivation

Clients of SGLang's Rust server currently vendor the `sglang.api.v1` `.proto` files and compile their own bindings. This PR makes `rust/sglang-api-types` publishable on crates.io, so they can depend on a versioned crate instead.

The published crate contains `sglang.api.v1` only. The deprecated `sglang.runtime.v1` bindings move to an internal, unpublished crate.

## Modifications

**1. `Move the runtime.v1 bindings out of sglang-api-types`**
- New internal crate `rust/sglang-runtime-v1-types` holding the generated `sglang.runtime.v1` bindings so they do not get published.
- `cargo gen-api` writes the runtime.v1 target there.
- `sglang-grpc` and `sgl-router` depend on the new crate.

**2. `Publishing to crates.io`**
- `sglang-api-types`: its own version (`0.1.0`), independent of SGLang releases.
-  crates.io metadata (repository, homepage, readme, keywords, categories, `include`)
- New `.github/workflows/release-crate-api-types.yml`:
  - On PRs touching the crate, regenerate the bindings with `cargo gen-api` and fail on any difference.
  - On an `api-types-v<version>` tag in `sgl-project/sglang`, the same checks, plus the tag must match the crate version and `cargo-semver-checks` must pass against the latest release on crates.io.

Releases are manual:
1. Bump `version` in `rust/sglang-api-types/Cargo.toml`.
2. Merge.
3. Push an `api-types-v<version>` tag on that commit.

One-time setup is needed to publish the first version by hand.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no model, kernel or serving-path changes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Tests

- `cargo gen-api` regenerates every checked-in binding with no diff.
- `rust/` workspace: `cargo build` and `cargo test --workspace` pass, excluding `sglang-bench`'s `tests/grpc.rs`, which fails to compile on `main` (its mock server lacks the HiCache RPCs) independently of this PR.
- `sgl-router`: `cargo check --all-targets`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test --lib --test proxy` pass (1097 + 224 passed).
- `cargo package --list -p sglang-api-types` contains only the api.v1 sources, tests and README; `cargo publish -p sglang-api-types --locked --dry-run` passes.
- A standalone crate outside the repository, depending on the packaged crate with every dependency from crates.io, builds the api.v1 gRPC client and round-trips a `GenerateRequest`.
- `actionlint` and `shellcheck` pass on the workflow; its shell steps were run locally (bindings check; tag/version match and mismatch).
- `pre-commit` passes on the touched files.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,138 @@
+name: Crate (sglang-api-types)
+
+# Pull requests: check that the sglang-api-types crate is publishable.
+# api-types-v<version> tags in sgl-project/sglang: publish it to crates.io.
+# Release steps: rust/sglang-api-types/README.md.
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - "proto/**"
+      - "python/sglang/api/v1/**"
+      - "rust/sglang-api-codegen/**"
+      - "rust/sglang-api-types/**"
+      - "rust/Cargo.lock"
+      - "rust/Cargo.toml"
+      - "rust/rust-toolchain.toml"
+      - ".github/workflows/release-crate-api-types.yml"
+  push:
+    tags:
+      - "api-types-v*"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: crate-api-types-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: rust
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Install Rust toolchain
+        working-directory: .
+        run: bash scripts/ci/utils/install_rustup.sh
+
+      # cargo gen-api uses its vendored protoc when PROTOC is unset.
+      - name: Regenerate the api.v1 bindings and compare
+        run: |
+          env -u PROTOC cargo gen-api --locked
+          outputs=(sglang-api-types ../python/sglang/api/v1)
+          if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- "${outputs[@]}")" ]]; then
+            git diff -- "${outputs[@]}"
+            echo "::error::Run 'cargo gen-api' in rust/ and commit the regenerated files."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      - name: Match the tag to the crate version
+        if: github.event_name == 'push'
+        run: |
+          crate_version=$(cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 |
+            jq -er '.packages[] | select(.name == "sglang-api-types") | .version')
+          tag_version=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#api-types-v}
+          if [[ "$tag_version" != "$crate_version" ]]; then
+            echo "::error::Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME, but rust/sglang-api-types is at $crate_version."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      - name: Package the crate
+        if: github.event_name != 'push'
+        run: cargo package -p sglang-api-types --locked
+
+      - name: Build the crate as crates.io would
+        if: github.event_name == 'push'
+        run: cargo publish -p sglang-api-types --locked --dry-run
+
+  # Tags only: protocol PRs leave the version unchanged until a release bumps it.
+  semver-gate:
+    if: github.event_name == 'push'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Compare with the latest release on crates.io
+        uses: obi1kenobi/cargo-semver-checks-action@6b69fcf40e9b5fb17adeb57e4b6ecd020649a239 # v2.9
+        with:
+          manifest-path: rust/sglang-api-types/Cargo.toml
+          package: sglang-api-types
+
+  release:
+    needs: [verify, semver-gate]
+    if: github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang' && github.event_name == 'push'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    environment: crates-io
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: rust
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout the tagged commit
+        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Install Rust toolchain
+        working-directory: .
+        run: bash scripts/ci/utils/install_rustup.sh
+
+      # 0.1.0 is uploaded by hand, so its tag finds it already there.
+      - name: Check whether this version is already on crates.io
+        id: published
+        run: |
+          version=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#api-types-v}
+          if curl -fsS https://index.crates.io/sg/la/sglang-api-types |
+            jq -es --arg version "$version" 'any(.[]; .vers == $version)' > /dev/null; then
+            echo "sglang-api-types $version is already on crates.io; skipping the upload."
+            echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          fi
+
+      # crates.io Trusted Publishing: a short-lived token, no stored secret.
+      - name: Get a crates.io token
+        if: steps.published.outputs.skip != 'true'
+        id: crates-io-token
+        uses: rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action@c6f97d42243bad5fab37ca0427f495c86d5b1a18 # v1.0.5
+
+      - name: Upload to crates.io
+        if: steps.published.outputs.skip != 'true'
+        env:
+          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.crates-io-token.outputs.token }}
+        run: cargo publish -p sglang-api-types --locked

@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+# sglang-api-types crate
+
+Rust bindings for SGLang's `sglang.api.v1` API: the prost messages, the tonic
+client and server for `SglangService`, and the JSON serde used by SGLang's HTTP
+API. The bindings are generated from `proto/sglang/api/v1` by `cargo gen-api`
+and checked in, so building the crate needs no `protoc` or build script.
+SGLang's own Rust server uses this same crate.
+
+```toml
+[dependencies]
+sglang-api-types = "0.1"
+```
+
+The gRPC client lives at
+`sglang_api_types::api::v1::sglang_service_client::SglangServiceClient`.
+The public API uses tonic 0.14 and prost 0.14 types.
+
+## Releases and versions
+
+`sglang-api-types` is versioned on its own semver track, independent of SGLang releases.
+Releases are made manually:
+
+1. Bump `version` in `Cargo.toml`: the minor version (for example 0.1 to 0.2)
+   for any schema, generated-API, or dependency change, since even a new field
+   can break Rust callers; the patch version for documentation or metadata only.
+2. Once the bump is on main, a maintainer can tag that commit
+   `api-types-v<version>` and push the tag. That tag starts
+   `release-crate-api-types.yml`, which refuses a tag that differs from the
+   `Cargo.toml` version, runs `cargo-semver-checks` against the latest release
+   on crates.io, and then uploads the crate.

+name: Crate (sglang-api-types)
+
+# Pull requests: check that the sglang-api-types crate is publishable.

+# Release steps: rust/sglang-api-types/README.md.
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - "proto/**"

+      - "rust/sglang-api-codegen/**"

+      - "rust/Cargo.lock"
+      - "rust/Cargo.toml"
+      - "rust/rust-toolchain.toml"
+      - ".github/workflows/release-crate-api-types.yml"
+  push:
+    tags:
+      - "api-types-v*"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: crate-api-types-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: rust
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Install Rust toolchain
+        working-directory: .
+        run: bash scripts/ci/utils/install_rustup.sh
+
+      # cargo gen-api uses its vendored protoc when PROTOC is unset.
+      - name: Regenerate the api.v1 bindings and compare

+          env -u PROTOC cargo gen-api --locked

+# Pull requests: check that the sglang-api-types crate is publishable.
+# api-types-v<version> tags in sgl-project/sglang: publish it to crates.io.
+# Release steps: rust/sglang-api-types/README.md.

+on:
+  pull_request:

+      - "python/sglang/api/v1/**"
+      - "rust/sglang-api-codegen/**"
+      - "rust/sglang-api-types/**"
+      - "rust/Cargo.lock"
+      - "rust/Cargo.toml"
+      - "rust/rust-toolchain.toml"
+      - ".github/workflows/release-crate-api-types.yml"
+  push:
+    tags:
+      - "api-types-v*"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: crate-api-types-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: rust
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Install Rust toolchain
+        working-directory: .
+        run: bash scripts/ci/utils/install_rustup.sh
+
+      # cargo gen-api uses its vendored protoc when PROTOC is unset.
+      - name: Regenerate the api.v1 bindings and compare
+        run: |
+          env -u PROTOC cargo gen-api --locked
+          outputs=(sglang-api-types ../python/sglang/api/v1)
+          if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- "${outputs[@]}")" ]]; then
+            git diff -- "${outputs[@]}"
+            echo "::error::Run 'cargo gen-api' in rust/ and commit the regenerated files."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      - name: Match the tag to the crate version
+        if: github.event_name == 'push'
+        run: |
+          crate_version=$(cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 |
+            jq -er '.packages[] | select(.name == "sglang-api-types") | .version')
+          tag_version=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#api-types-v}
+          if [[ "$tag_version" != "$crate_version" ]]; then
+            echo "::error::Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME, but rust/sglang-api-types is at $crate_version."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      - name: Build the crate as crates.io would
+        run: cargo publish -p sglang-api-types --locked --dry-run
+
+  # Tags only: protocol PRs leave the version unchanged until a release bumps it.
+  semver-gate:
+    if: github.event_name == 'push'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Compare with the latest release on crates.io
+        uses: obi1kenobi/cargo-semver-checks-action@6b69fcf40e9b5fb17adeb57e4b6ecd020649a239 # v2.9
+        with:
+          manifest-path: rust/sglang-api-types/Cargo.toml
+          package: sglang-api-types
+
+  release:
+    needs: [verify, semver-gate]
+    if: github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang' && github.event_name == 'push'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    environment: crates-io
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: rust
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout the tagged commit
+        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Install Rust toolchain
+        working-directory: .
+        run: bash scripts/ci/utils/install_rustup.sh
+
+      # crates.io Trusted Publishing: a short-lived token, no stored secret.
+      - name: Get a crates.io token
+        id: crates-io-token
+        uses: rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action@c6f97d42243bad5fab37ca0427f495c86d5b1a18 # v1.0.5
+
+      - name: Upload to crates.io
+        env:
+          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.crates-io-token.outputs.token }}
+        run: cargo publish -p sglang-api-types --locked
